cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Of course. Put that before pudding so we finish on something nice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book another dinner. I want us to keep seeing each other without either evening running over.

mechanism: A presides over reconciliation as its only competent organizer and corrects requests into convenient boundaries.
confusable: Healthy mutual boundaries differ from A teaching B how repair must work for A's comfort.
comparison: Dinner timing contains upset; a weekend plan redirects difficult speech into a controlled written channel.
seedUse: Retain the seeds' concrete restrictions while showing A correcting the process throughout.
